_comment: Worker-class manifest, renders prompts/code/change-proposer.md. Code change-proposer: an ephemeral worker that builds ONE ticket's bounded code change as a diff in a disposable worktree, runs the granted test runner to verify, commits, and exits. The broker pushes a feature branch and opens an MR (never the default branch, human-gated). Repo-agnostic and runner-agnostic: the per-ticket target repo, its test runner and the ticket body ride the runtime -p brief (like the inbox triage class's per-account posture), so this one signed prompt serves every code repo. sections = ordered module paths (no .md); vars fill {{slots}} at build time. Content is operator-gated: the rendered prompt's sha256 must be signed into approved-prompts.json by the operator before it runs.
